security.title: Security Center
security.desc: All messages from the official Telegram service account (shown in your phone as "Telegram" / +42777, internal user_id 777000) — per account. New messages also trigger a desktop notification. Use "Pull latest 50" to backfill history for a newly added account.
security.noMessages: No messages from Telegram yet. Try "Pull latest 50" to fetch history from Telegram.
security.bulk2faDesc: Sets a new Two-Step password on every selected account. Accounts without 2FA get it turned on. Accounts that already have 2FA need their current password — we try each account's remembered password first (saved when you logged in), then the list below, at most 5 tries per account.
security.rememberedCount: We currently remember {{count}} password(s) from login.
security.currentPwdsHint: For accounts that already have 2FA with a password we don't remember. Tried in order until one works.
security.bulk2faConfirm:
Set/change the Two-Step password on {{count}} account(s)?

For accounts that already have 2FA, your remembered passwords{{bank}} are tried (up to 5 per account).
security.allSessionsDesc: One click will remove every other Telegram login/device from every connected account, while keeping this app's current Telegram session active.
security.terminateAllConfirm:
Terminate other Telegram sessions on {{count}} account(s)?

The current session used by this app is kept active for each account. Your Multi TG Manager website login will not be logged out.
security.set2faSaveFailed: 2FA set, but the password couldn't be saved locally
security.changed2faSaveFailed: 2FA changed (try {{tried}}), but the password couldn't be saved locally

messaging.title: Messages
messaging.noReactionsChosen: No reactions chosen yet — click “Set Reactions & %”.
messaging.wipeDesc: Paste a @username (or t.me link). For every selected account, the WHOLE conversation with that user is deleted for both sides (revoke) and the chat is removed — it stops existing. Permanent, cannot be undone.
messaging.increasePct: Increase the percentages — no accounts got assigned
messaging.wipeConfirm:
Wipe the ENTIRE chat with "{{target}}" from {{count}} account(s)?

Every message in that conversation is deleted for BOTH sides (revoke=true)
and the chat is removed completely — it will no longer exist.

This is PERMANENT and cannot be undone.
messaging.noChatToWipe: No chat with this user — nothing to wipe

chat.tip: Tip: paste a referral link like t.me/Bot?start=CODE — Open fires the bot /start so the referral counts.
chat.notConnected: This account is {{status}} — connect it to chat.
chat.emptyOpen: Open a chat above by pasting a @username or a t.me link to start messaging like Telegram.

checker.title: Target Checker
checker.desc: Search one bot, channel, group, or username across every connected account. It will show which accounts have already used or joined it, and which ones have not.

bulk.title: Bulk
bulk.csvFormat: Format: each line = firstname,lastname,username,bio (tab or comma). Row N applies to selected account N. Any field can be blank to skip it. Username must be unique per account (Telegram rule) — taken ones are reported per account.
bulk.csvIgnoresFields: When CSV is loaded, the fields below are ignored.
bulk.usernameUniqueHint: Must be unique per account. Use "Append number" below to auto-generate (e.g., myuser1, myuser2), or use CSV for custom usernames.
bulk.photoHint: Pick photos in batches (click "Choose Files" repeatedly to accumulate). Photo #1 → account #1, photo #2 → account #2, etc. Extra photos are ignored; if there are fewer photos than accounts, the remaining accounts are skipped.
bulk.orderMatters: Order matters: row N of CSV / photo #N → account #N (top to bottom of this list).
bulk.setFieldOrCsv: Set at least one field, or load a CSV
bulk.usernameUnique: Username must be unique. Enable "Append number" or use CSV for multiple accounts.
bulk.applyPhotosConfirm: Apply {{usable}} photo(s) to {{count}} accounts in order?{{extra}}{{missing}}

reaction.title: Choose Reactions & %
reaction.desc: Pick reactions and drag each bar to set what share of the {{count}} selected account(s) react with it. Any reaction the chat has disabled is simply skipped (shown in the results) — no error.
reaction.reactionsOff: This chat has reactions turned OFF — no reaction will work here.
reaction.someAllowed: This chat allows only the reactions shown below. Others will be skipped.
reaction.allStdNoCustom: All standard emoji are allowed here, but custom (premium) emoji are not.
reaction.couldntRead: Couldn't read this chat's allowed reactions ({{err}}). You can still pick standard emoji — disabled ones get skipped.
reaction.tipPasteFirst: Tip: paste the post link first to see exactly which reactions this chat allows.
reaction.addAtLeastOne: Add at least one reaction above.
reaction.totalOver100: Total is over 100% — lower some bars.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageDesc: Choose the display language for this dashboard.
settings.rateLimitDesc: Delay between each account in every bulk task (join, leave, send, react, view). Tasks run one account at a time and wait a random amount in this window before the next. Lower = faster, but too low can get accounts flagged. Default 1–2s.
settings.parallelDesc: How many accounts a bulk task runs at once. Higher = faster. Telegram limits are per-account, so running different accounts in parallel is safe. Default 5.
settings.sessionsFolderHint: Change takes effect on next backend restart.
settings.playSound: Play notification sound for new alerts
